$comment: Shape validation only. Required-ness is enforced per-template with helm's `required` function, so rendering one workflow family never demands another family's values.

family.$comment: Set by the renderer to the selected family; gates which template body evaluates (helm evaluates all templates even under -s).

publish.$comment: Emit per-run inputs as {{params.*}} tokens (a saveable family) instead of literals.

slug.$comment: Git-branch-safe: lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen. Empty passes shape validation; the template rejects it via `required`.

verifyCmd.$comment: Shell command that proves the implementation (run in the worktree by a trailing verify step). Empty omits the step.

createPr.$comment: Append a commit/push/PR epilogue to the run's final step. Direct renders only; a published family carries the epilogue keyed off the fire-time createPr param instead.
